Class TemporalRasterInterpolator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.TemporalRasterInterpolator
public final class TemporalRasterInterpolator extends Object
Stateless cartographic raster naming normalizer and linear ARGB cross-epoch image interpolator supporting both headless AWT BufferedImage and JavaFX Image textures.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

  • Method Details

    • normalizePlanet

      public static String normalizePlanet(String planet)
      Resolves the canonical directory name for a planet (e.g. "terre" -> "earth"), stripping path-traversal characters to enforce filesystem containment.
      Parameters:
      planet - raw planet identifier
      Returns:
      sanitized canonical planet directory name

    • canonicalLayerTag

      public static String canonicalLayerTag(String layerName)
      Standardizes an arbitrary layer filename or alias into its short canonical tag (e.g. "earth_1000_density.png" -> "density").
      Parameters:
      layerName - raw layer path, filename, or alias
      Returns:
      canonical layer tag

    • interpolateBufferedImages

      public static BufferedImage interpolateBufferedImages(BufferedImage img0, BufferedImage img1, double t)
      Performs linear cross-fade blending between two headless BufferedImage scalar raster maps using scanline-buffered 32-bit ARGB integer arithmetic.
      Parameters:
      img0 - earlier baseline raster
      img1 - later target raster
      t - barycentric interpolation factor in [0.0, 1.0]
      Returns:
      interpolated BufferedImage

    • interpolateImages

      public static javafx.scene.image.Image interpolateImages(javafx.scene.image.Image img0, javafx.scene.image.Image img1, double t)
      Performs linear cross-fade blending between two JavaFX Image raster maps.
      Parameters:
      img0 - earlier baseline raster
      img1 - later target raster
      t - barycentric interpolation factor in [0.0, 1.0]
      Returns:
      interpolated JavaFX WritableImage
